verdict.rationale: Square documents official, language-idiomatic server SDKs for .NET, Java, Python, Ruby and PHP, plus an official TypeScript library on GitHub with code samples. It also ships a Mobile Payments SDK for iOS and Android, and the .NET SDK has quickstart and migration docs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Square TypeScript library provides convenient access to the Square APIs from TypeScript.
The Square Python library supports Square APIs in a language-idiomatic way that reduces complexity without sacrificing API functionality.
The Square Java library supports Square APIs in a language-idiomatic way that reduces complexity without sacrificing API functionality.
Use the Mobile Payments SDK to accept in-person payments in iOS and Android
